activation_requirements: delivery channel explicitly configured when delivery is wanted

schedules.name: Lohi daily completeness
schedules.prompt_template: Use lohi-revenue-observer-v1 in daily_completeness mode. Evaluate the previous complete HCM day; follow the readiness gate, observation-key, deduplication, Plans-write, and delivery rules exactly.

schedules.name: Lohi weekly mature cohort
schedules.prompt_template: Use lohi-revenue-observer-v1 in weekly_mature_cohort mode. Evaluate the last completed HCM week and only cohorts with at least 14 fully elapsed days; follow the readiness gate, observation-key, deduplication, Plans-write, and delivery rules exactly.

finding.idempotency_decision: Plans atomically claims (project, operation, idempotency_key) for identical requests; a different request under the same observation key conflicts and must be surfaced, never retried under a new key. A matching existing finding remains eligible for at-least-once notification redelivery, so a missed delivery is repairable; successful overlaps may duplicate and delivery is not exactly-once.

delivery.on_missing_channel: keep the Plans finding and run-history result; surface that delivery was skipped
delivery.on_denied_finding_write: record the run failure and do not deliver an unrecorded assertion
delivery.guarantee: at-least-once retry for matching findings; successful overlaps may duplicate; no exactly-once promise
